system.description:
The countermage extends their protective art beyond their own skin, shielding whatever they hold from a rival's sorcery.

Using Countermagic is a free action. Make a Mental Challenge against the caster with two extra Traits; on a win the opposed Thaumaturgy power or ritual fails. You may now cancel a power or ritual that affects anyone or anything in physical contact with you (so you can counter a foe's Flesh of Fiery Touch while they grapple you, though not an object hurled at you by Movement of the Mind). Your rating must equal or exceed the power opposed, and it is fully effective only against Tremere Thaumaturgy, weakened by four Traits against other blood magic.
